arguments.query: SELECT status, count(*), min(order_ts), max(order_ts) FROM orders GROUP BY status
SELECT method, payment_status, count(*), count(distinct order_id) FROM payments GROUP BY 1,2

SELECT o.status, count(*) n, sum(exists(select 1 from payments p where p.order_id=o.order_id and p.payment_status='ok')) paid_ok, sum(exists(select 1 from payments p where p.order_id=o.order_id)) anypay, sum(exists(select 1 from shipments s where s.order_id=o.order_id)) shipped, sum(exists(select 1 from shipments s where s.order_id=o.order_id and delivered_ts is not null and delivered_ts<>'')) deliv, sum(exists(select 1 from refunds r where r.order_id=o.order_id)) refunded FROM orders o GROUP BY o.status
SELECT o.status, count(*) n, count(p.order_id) paid_ok FROM orders o LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM payments WHERE payment_status='ok') p ON p.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY o.status
SELECT o.status, count(*) n, count(s.order_id) sh FROM orders o LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM shipments) s ON s.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY o.status
SELECT o.status, count(*) n, count(s.order_id) rf FROM orders o LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM refunds) s ON s.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY o.status

SELECT p.method, count(*), round(100.0*count(*)/sum(count(*)) over (),4) FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id AND p.payment_status='ok' WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) AND o.order_ts>='2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts<'2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.method
